author: Murphh
body:
Hi - I was playing walls on the yellow team on the Wild West map.  These two players were stalking me. I got to a chest first, so I guess they were mad.
I went to get the blazerod in a chest by lava and they spleefed me.  Look at chat. 
I told them that was uncool and they said just to go join another game like it was no big deal.
